topic: Using Smart Pointers to Manage Resources
explanation: Smart pointers are crucial for modern C++ programming, offering automatic memory management and preventing memory leaks.  They act as wrappers around raw pointers, automatically deleting the pointed-to object when the smart pointer goes out of scope.  This eliminates the need for manual `delete` calls, reducing errors and making code safer and easier to maintain.  Choosing the right type of smart pointer (unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr) depends on the ownership and sharing semantics required.
